---
title: "Finding us"
---

**Brain Research Imaging Centre (BRIC)**\
Research Way, Plymouth Science Park, Plymouth, PL6 8BU

BRIC is at the far end of the brown-brick building on Davy Road, next to Derriford Hospital. Look for the BRIC sign by the glass entrance. We'll meet you there.

[Open in Google Maps →](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Brain+Research+Imaging+Centre+Research+Way+Plymouth+PL6+8BU){.btn .btn-primary}

## Getting here

- **Bus.** Route 51 stops at Miller Way and Research Way, a short walk away. Buses to Derriford Hospital also stop nearby.
- **Car.** Please [contact us](contact.qmd) before your visit if you plan to park.
- **Running late or lost?** Email [dylan.curtin@plymouth.ac.uk](mailto:dylan.curtin@plymouth.ac.uk).

If you have any access needs, [let us know](contact.qmd) before your visit and we'll make arrangements.
